subject: english
title: Sentence Parts · Q3 W10 D04
objective: Identify who or what the sentence is about and what that subject does or is.
introduction: Milo and his friends are doing a project! 🐱✨ Find who does the action and what they do in each sentence.

vocabulary.definition: Milo is the subject (who), and "reads" is the predicate (what he does).
The plants are the subject (what), and "grow" is the predicate.
Maxine is the subject (who), and "draws" is the predicate.
